population: Original common G2 fitting and strict validation/test response IDs; preserve original split.

design.D: eta = beta + sum_j gamma_j(demographic_j); predicts displayed-A tendencies only.
design.Cat+D: eta = beta + sum_j gamma_j + (c_A-c_B) + sum_j (v_j,A-v_j,B). Cat scores pool photos of a cat.
design.Y+D: eta = beta + sum_j gamma_j + w^T delta_Y + sum_j v_j^T delta_Y.
design.C+D: eta = beta + sum_j gamma_j + w^T delta_C + sum_j v_j^T delta_C.
design.additivity: One set of deviations per eligible nonreference category per demographic; no cross-demographic/profile interaction products.
design.side_effects: All models use the same additive demographic displayed-A effects to separate side tendencies from score interactions.
design.reference: Per demographic, largest fitting-response eligible category; lexical tie.
design.support: Category needs >=100 fitting responses and >=30 distinct fitting pairs. Unsupported/unseen categories have zero side/score deviation and are explicitly counted.
design.missing: Separate <missing>; documented MBTI unknown is retained. Gender vocabulary is audited rather than assumed.
design.visual: Use full original admitted Y numeric/categorical encoding and all 576 CNN coordinates separately. No H/C/Y fusion.
design.preprocessing: Recompute Y/C on unique original common fitting photos and require equality with frozen specifications.

selection.objective: Mean stable response logistic loss + ridge/2 on side and pooled score coefficients + ridge*rho/2 on score interactions + 1e-6/2 on intercept.
selection.optimizer: Existing float64 zero-start L-BFGS-B; max gradient <1e-5; existing one-retry policy.
selection.no_interaction_fallback: For each Cat/Y/C branch select a side-adjusted no-score-interaction model on validation, then include its exact copied logits as a candidate for the requested interaction model.
selection.ties: Within 1e-6 prefer exact no-interaction fallback, otherwise larger ridge then rho.
selection.test: Freeze specification/encoding/preprocessing/model choices before reading already-saved G2 test outcomes. No raw test label parsing, tuning or representation winner on test.

evaluation.bootstrap: 5000 identical unordered-pair draws for all models; seed 20261101; preserve all responses and sampled pair multiplicity; recompute response denominator.
evaluation.intervals: 95% pointwise exploratory, not multiplicity adjusted, conditional on selected fits.
evaluation.comparators: Original frozen M0/M1/M3-Y/M3-C/M4-C/M3-side/M4-side and each new matched no-interaction side-adjusted branch.
evaluation.subgroups: Within/between cat and six individual demographics; report estimates only at >=100 responses and >=30 pairs, otherwise counts with low-support flag.
evaluation.calibration: 10 equal-width overall bins, mark <30 responses or <10 pairs low support.
evaluation.coefficients: Provide full signed side/score coefficients with actual names; no automatic demographic-preference discoveries or causal importance claims.

limitations: Experiment proposed after the original G2 test and exploratory demographic outcome analyses; not confirmatory or an independent holdout.
Displayed A is not established to be screen-left; randomization is unverified. Side effects do not prove innate group bias.
Demographics-only cannot rank unseen cats/photos or identify which visual traits people prefer.
Cat/semantic interactions are conditional model-based predictive associations, not causal preferences, true pedigree or individual effects.
Correlated demographics, sparse support and many parameters may yield unstable coefficients; thresholds are not power guarantees.
Pair bootstrap omits training-selection uncertainty and all respondent/shared-image dependence.
Original G2/G3/G4 models, claims, report, archive and official prediction artifacts remain unchanged.
